source.title: Announcement of new Senior Delegate - Europe and Africa (October 2022)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Senior Delegate for Europe - Simone Cantarelli. The Board did not receive any applications for the Senior Delegate for Africa, and as such the Board will take on that role at this time.

We would like to thank Laura Ohrndorf for her service as Senior Delegate for Europe, and Brent Boswell for his service as Senior Delegate for Africa.

Simone was selected by the WCA Board by voting among them, following Section 4 of our [Motion](http://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2022.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf) about Senior Delegates.

We wish Simone Cantarelli the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties. His term as Senior Delegate began on October 1, 2022.

Simone was among two applicants we had and both candidacy documents can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vLs7M1aEajSHsNlIpkKOv0cgBoKSX2FZ) if you are interested in viewing them.

Other than Simone, the following applicant for Europe was:

* Sam Spendla

translation.title: 欧洲及非洲高级代表任命公告（2022 年 10 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Simone Cantarelli 将出任欧洲地区的新任高级代表。董事会没有收到非洲高级代表职位的申请，因此现阶段将由董事会承担这一职责。

感谢 Laura Ohrndorf 担任欧洲高级代表期间的工作，也感谢 Brent Boswell 担任非洲高级代表期间的工作。

WCA 董事会依照[《关于高级代表的议案》](http://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2022.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf)第 4 节，经董事投票选出 Simone。

祝 Simone Cantarelli 在新的岗位上一切顺利。他的高级代表任期自 2022 年 10 月 1 日开始。

我们共收到两份申请，Simone 是其中一位申请人。如有兴趣，两份申请材料均可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vLs7M1aEajSHsNlIpkKOv0cgBoKSX2FZ)查看。

除 Simone 外，欧洲职位的另一位申请人是：

* Sam Spendla
